# Registry of shipped models and the data behind them

Synthetic and not validated. The models table is generated from `models/manifest.json` by
`python -m research.manifest --registry`: do not edit between its markers. The rest is written by hand. `commit at run` is the branch commit when the run was made; after the squash merge, find the run by its run id and the pull request.

## Datasets

| Dataset | Card | Licence | What it is used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| ward-v2, ward-v2-train, ward-v2-ext (simulator trials) | `models/data/ward-v2/card.md`, `models/data/ward-v2-ext/card.md` | None stated in the cards: synthetic trials made by our own simulator (`synthetic: true`, no real patient), so there is no third-party licence | Training, validation, calibration and held-out scoring of every model above, by seed range (see the cards) |
| eICU-CRD Demo 2.0.1 (real ICU records) | `models/data/eicu-crd-demo/card.md` | ODbL 1.0 (open access, no account); attribution and share-alike apply to public use, nothing from it is committed | Only to measure NEWS2 and the baseline rule on real records. Never used to train a model |
| ward-v2-heldout2 (simulator trials, seeds 1001 to 1400) | `models/data/ward-v2-heldout2/card.md` | None stated in the card: synthetic trials made by our own simulator, no real patient | Held-out set 2 only. Declared before it was read; each evaluation command reads it once. Never used to train, tune, calibrate or learn. |
| CPSC 2021 1.0.0 (real ECG recordings with paroxysmal AF; PhysioNet) | No card yet: not used by any model or fit. `SOURCE.md` beside the files, outside the repository | CC BY 4.0 (the archive's `LICENSE.txt`) | Downloaded 2026-11-14 after owner decision models-rl-3; all 4,293 files match PhysioNet's `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Not used yet. Planned: summary statistics only, as a held-out realism check of the simulator's rhythm, after 18 November. |
| SHDB-AF 1.0.1 (real Holter ECG with AF; PhysioNet) | No card yet: not used by any model or fit. `SOURCE.md` beside the files, outside the repository | ODC-By 1.0 (the archive's `LICENSE.txt`) | Downloaded 2026-11-14 after owner decision models-rl-3; all 488 files match PhysioNet's `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Not used yet. Planned: summary statistics only (AF episode lengths, burden, rate), as a held-out realism check, after 18 November. |
